name: Papaya with ant salt
nameVi: Đu đủ giã muối kiến vàng
summary: Pounded papaya with weaver-ant salt, an Êđê plate served beside pounded bitter eggplant. Guests at one tasting called that table hot and bitter.
origin: Bao Dak Lak on 26 Jul 2023 names đu đủ giã muối kiến vàng among the plates at a tasting on Đường sách cà phê.
howToEat: It came to the table with pounded bitter eggplant and the cassava-leaf stir-fry.
where: Đường sách cà phê, at a highland tasting.
seoTitle: Du du gia muoi kien — papaya with ant salt
seoDescription: Pounded papaya with weaver-ant salt, an Ede plate served with pounded bitter eggplant in Buon Ma Thuot.
